basic_details.job_title: KVS Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 15 ATL Instructor, Vocational Instructor Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: ATL Instructor: B.E., B.Tech. Electronic & Communication Engineering with minimum one year experience. Vocational Instructor: B.E, B.Tech/ M.Tech (Electronic & Communication Engineering) with minimum one year experience.

how_to_apply: Appear at one of the four venue KVs on 21-11-2026 for registration between 08:00 AM and 9:30 AM.
Carry 02 passport size photographs, original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies of the certificates for verification.
Collect the application form at the venue on the day of the interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. The interview may go on till evening. Updates are on https://rotinsukia.kvs.gov.in/ and the websites of the four venue KVs.

content_sections.text: Empanelment and engagement for the remaining part of the academic session 2026-27. Strictly temporary and need-based as per KVS norms. Selected candidates are likely to be offered posts at KVs within the KVS Tinsukia Region, subject to vacancy.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear at one of the four venue KVs on 21-11-2026 for registration between 08:00 AM and 9:30 AM. Carry 02 passport size photographs, original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies of the certificates for verification. Collect the application form at the venue on the day of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. The interview may go on till evening. Updates are on https://rotinsukia.kvs.gov.in/ and the websites of the four venue KVs.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for KVS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21 November 2026, and candidates report at 8:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KVS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies: ATL Instructor, Vocational Instructor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KVS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 21 November 2026 at 8:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: KV No.1 Imphal; PM SHRI KV No.1 Itanagar; KV Dibrugarh; PM SHRI KV Dimapur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 30,000 for ATL Instructor, Rs. 30,000 for Vocational Instructor.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ATL Instructor: B.E., B.Tech. Electronic & Communication Engineering with minimum one year experience. Vocational Instructor: B.E, B.Tech/ M.Tech (Electronic & Communication Engineering) with minimum one year experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Engagement is purely part-time.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Selection is based on interview performance and fulfilment of eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Empanelment and engagement for the remaining part of the academic session 2026-27. Strictly temporary and need-based as per KVS norms. Selected candidates are likely to be offered posts at KVs within the KVS Tinsukia Region, subject to vacancy.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by KVS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KV No.1 Imphal, PM SHRI KV No.1 Itanagar, KV Dibrugarh, PM SHRI KV Dimapur, KVs of Tinsukia Region (Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Nagaland and Upper Assam).
